title: Grounded strategy suggestions for repeated Zebra developer questions
goal: Recommend a minimal, testable cross-case pattern taxonomy and one evidence-aware answer policy. Keep documentation revisions and model answer quality as separate evaluation targets. Start from publicly published software/documentation cases; do not use private SPR source records. Suggest tests and criteria; do not report performance gains without held-out model runs.
constraints: Preserve the current published application behavior and the team's documented case-to-TechDocs source trail.
Proposed patterns are provisional until multiple cases and a human reviewer support each grouping.
Never infer that documentation is missing merely because retrieval failed.
Do not present a pattern flag as a confirmed defect or as a device test.
Require version/product applicability and evidence links for any suggested AI response.
Keep diagram/video guidance optional and source-grounded; no fabricated demonstration.
Output a narrowly scoped patch proposal, test plan, and limitations; do not edit code automatically.
acceptance_checks: A proposed pattern has an explicit definition and an example of a disconfirming case.
Any output requiring device behavior is labeled NEEDS_DEVICE_TEST.
A before/after answer evaluation freezes prompts, public evidence bytes, model identity and output receipts.
Blind evaluation examples are held out from strategy drafting.
Neither model uses restricted client sources or silently submits to a public forum.
